To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
students are motivated to learn online because of the convenience of the medium, but that this motivation can wane if they do not feel they are getting enough support.

1) students are emotionally engaged in their learning; 2) the emotional experience of learning is not a single event, but a complex and dynamic process that unfolds over time; 3) the emotional experience can vary from positive to negative, from excitement to frustration; and 4) emotional experience is affected by the context of the student's learning.
• The students' experience of the course and the online environment is central to their emotional engagement with the course.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the student as a whole person, with a life outside the online learning environment, with a life that impacts on their learning and engagement.
the whole life of an online student, and the whole student in an online life.
the whole person, and with the whole of their learning experience, not just their behaviour in an online learning space.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the studies demonstrate the value of a whole person approach to understanding online student engagement and motivation, as well as the value of qualitative research in understanding the student's experience of learning.
online students' emotional lives are complex and nuanced, and that the online environment is one of the many contexts that contribute to the whole life of an individual student.
students' engagement with learning, including their emotional engagement, is complex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the student is an individual, not a data point, and that the online student is an individual with a life outside the online course.
students' engagement is complex and multi-faceted, and that the online learning environment can support or undermine this engagement.
the online student is a real student, with a real life, and that the emotional context of the learning is an important factor in understanding their behaviour and engagement.
The main takeaway from our work is that

students' learning experiences are not only about their engagement with the online learning environment but about their whole life experiences, which include the emotional and social aspects of being a student.
the emotional life of the student is an important part of their learning experience and that the online context is an important part in that emotional life.
, in order to design and deliver effective online courses, it is necessary to understand the whole person, not just their online presence.
